result_class_note: Latent query-conditioning REPLICATES decisively with independent-group inference on fresh vocabulary, and rank-1 movement exceeds RESULT B's 'remains near chance' description (partial-C signature on the ranking axis). PR5 greedy failed on the preregistered replication suite, so RESULT C is NOT earned. Classified B with recorded rank movement.
scientific_conclusion: Counterfactual query-swap training from the same parent installed a large, vocabulary-independent query-conditioned preference over candidate context values (paired group-level delta +2.486 nats on a fixture that never touched training, selection, or development), establishing that the original SFT5 signal reflected a real learning effect rather than split leakage or candidate-level pseudo-replication. The preference moves probability mass (rank-1 34%->53%) but does not yet control autoregressive generation under competition (greedy regressed); generic extraction survived exactly at its registered tolerance boundary.
phrasing_guard_P16_P17: Claimed: training caused the requested target to exert greater influence over candidate-value probabilities, across vocabulary. NOT claimed: 'vocabulary-bound' (disproven by v3), representation formation as fact (interpretation only; residual probe remains EXPLORATORY_ONLY).

next_research_question: What prevents an already-present query-conditioned value preference from dominating competing candidate priors at greedy decode time (margin/calibration vs context interference vs format breadth)?
next_training_decision_rationale: Per P24 a candidate-margin/ranking objective is now scientifically justified, but it requires its own preregistration BEFORE training; additionally the extraction gate passed by one item, so headroom must be widened/re-measured before further optimization pressure.
